WHAT JUST HAPPENED?

One request.
Different responsibilities.

What starts the trip?

Search sends an HTTP request after the browser resolves the domain and connects.

Why a CDN?

Nearby edge servers return cached public assets quickly. Dynamic requests continue to the application.

Who chooses the Pod?

The Service's networking routes to an eligible Ready Pod. The control plane is not a hop in each request.

What if something fails?

Routes may change, controllers may replace Pods, or the request may fail. Availability requires healthy alternatives and correct application logic.
